key: AMARIA: Oh, it's you!
en: AMARIA: Oh, it's you!
ja: アマリア: あら、あんたじゃない!

key: I heard you eloped with Lin, but you decided to come back after all?
en: I heard you eloped with Lin, but you decided to come back after all?
ja: リンと駆け落ちしたって聞いてたけど、結局戻ってきたんだ?

key: That's amazing.
en: That's amazing.
ja: すごいじゃない。

key: You're here to help out with this now too, right?
en: You're here to help out with this now too, right?
ja: 今度はこっちの手伝いに来てくれたってこと?

key: Here, look.
en: Here, look.
ja: ほら、見て。

key: These tablets are just covered in braille.
en: These tablets are just covered in braille.
ja: この石板、点字だらけなの。

key: I was originally going to try and deal with this myself since it's right by my house, but...
en: I was originally going to try and deal with this myself since it's right by my house, but...
ja: 最初は自分の家のすぐそばだから自分でなんとかしようとしてたんだけど……

key: Trying to translate this much text manually is just useless...
en: Trying to translate this much text manually is just useless...
ja: この量の文章を手作業で翻訳しようとしても、正直無理があるのよね……

key: I've been here for a while already and hardly made any progress.
en: I've been here for a while already and hardly made any progress.
ja: もうしばらくここにいるのに、ほとんど進んでなくて。

key: Frankly, I'm about ready to throw in the towel.
en: Frankly, I'm about ready to throw in the towel.
ja: 正直、もう投げ出しかけてるところ。

key: I think our best bet is to find someone who's already familiar with braille, but...
en: I think our best bet is to find someone who's already familiar with braille, but...
ja: 一番いいのは、点字に詳しい人を見つけることだと思うんだけど……

key: The only person I've heard of who was blind was the old guy in the Elite Four, and no one's heard from him since Lin disappeared.
en: The only person I've heard of who was blind was the old guy in the Elite Four, and no one's heard from him since Lin disappeared.
ja: 目の見えない人って聞いたことあるの、四天王のあのおじいさんだけなんだけど、リンが消えてからその人の話も全然聞かないし。

key: We'll probably have to find someone else, but I have no idea who...
en: We'll probably have to find someone else, but I have no idea who...
ja: 多分、他の誰かを探さなきゃいけないと思うけど、誰にすればいいか全然わかんない……

key: I don't suppose you know anyone else who might be able to translate this, do you?
en: I don't suppose you know anyone else who might be able to translate this, do you?
ja: もしかして、これを翻訳できそうな人、他に知らない?

key: For now, I think I'll just head back.
en: For now, I think I'll just head back.
ja: とりあえず、あたし戻ろうと思う。

key: Maybe I'll see if there's something else Tania and I can help with.
en: Maybe I'll see if there's something else Tania and I can help with.
ja: ターニアと二人で、他に手伝えることないか見てみるかも。

key: Bye for now~
en: Bye for now~
ja: それじゃ、またね～

key: AMARIA: Oh, you're back.
en: AMARIA: Oh, you're back.
ja: アマリア: あら、戻ってきたのね。

key: Julia told me you had eloped with Tania.
en: Julia told me you had eloped with Tania.
ja: ジュリアが、あんたがターニアと駆け落ちしたって言ってたけど。

key: I told her that wasn't a very funny joke.
en: I told her that wasn't a very funny joke.
ja: あんまり面白いジョークじゃないって言っといたわ。

key: Here to clean up the mess you left behind?
en: Here to clean up the mess you left behind?
ja: あんたが残していった後始末をしに来たの?

key: I guess you haven't really changed at all, have you?
en: I guess you haven't really changed at all, have you?
ja: 結局、あんたって全然変わってないのね?

key: AMARIA: Well, I'll just leave this in your ever-capable hands.
en: AMARIA: Well, I'll just leave this in your ever-capable hands.
ja: アマリア: まあ、これはあんたの頼りになる手にお任せするわ。

key: I thought I'd go see what the trouble was, being on my doorstep and all,
en: I thought I'd go see what the trouble was, being on my doorstep and all,
ja: うちのすぐそばだから、何のトラブルか見に来ようと思ったんだけど、

key: But all that seems to be here are these big tablets full of braille.
en: But all that seems to be here are these big tablets full of braille.
ja: ここにあるのは、点字だらけのでかい石板ばっかりみたいね。

key: As for trying to translate all that manually?
en: As for trying to translate all that manually?
ja: それを全部手作業で翻訳しようとするなんて?

key: No thanks.
en: No thanks.
ja: 遠慮しとくわ。

key: You'd probably be better off just finding someone who can read it naturally.
en: You'd probably be better off just finding someone who can read it naturally.
ja: 自然に読める人を見つけた方が、多分早いと思うわよ。

key: The only blind person I've heard of was the old guy in the Elite Four, and no one's heard from him since Lin disappeared.
en: The only blind person I've heard of was the old guy in the Elite Four, and no one's heard from him since Lin disappeared.
ja: 目の見えない人で聞いたことあるの、四天王のあのおじいさんだけなんだけど、リンが消えてからその人の話も全然聞かないし。

key: You'll probably have to find someone else.
en: You'll probably have to find someone else.
ja: 多分、他の誰かを探さなきゃいけないと思うわ。

key: Good luck~
en: Good luck~
ja: 頑張ってね～

key: Maybe I'll see you around the Nightclub sometime.
en: Maybe I'll see you around the Nightclub sometime.
ja: そのうちナイトクラブで会うかもね。

key: AMARIA: Or maybe not.
en: AMARIA: Or maybe not.
ja: アマリア: 会わないかもね。

key: DANIELLE: My, what kept you?
en: DANIELLE: My, what kept you?
ja: ダニエール: あら、遅かったじゃない。

key: I've more or less just about finished going over the whole bit.
en: I've more or less just about finished going over the whole bit.
ja: もうだいたい全部、目を通し終わったところよ。

key: Fortunately for you, this does translate to our language after all. Isn't that convenient?
en: Fortunately for you, this does translate to our language after all. Isn't that convenient?
ja: あんたにとって幸運なことに、これ、結局わたくしたちの言語に訳せるのよね。便利じゃない?

key: Now, there is the matter of how to go about acting on the information listed here...
en: Now, there is the matter of how to go about acting on the information listed here...
ja: さて、ここに書かれている情報を、どう行動に移すかという問題だけど……

key: You see, that tablet over there describes how in order to open the way forward, an actor must perform a certain ritual.
en: You see, that tablet over there describes how in order to open the way forward, an actor must perform a certain ritual.
ja: あそこの石板には、前に進む道を開くには、演者が特定の儀式を行わなければならないと書いてあるの。

key: And this tablet here lists the actions necessary for said ritual.
en: And this tablet here lists the actions necessary for said ritual.
ja: そしてこっちの石板には、その儀式に必要な動作が並んでいるわ。

key: And while I could simply tell you what's listed here...
en: And while I could simply tell you what's listed here...
ja: ここに書かれていることをただ教えてあげてもいいのだけれど……

key: Don't you think it's a bit dehumanizing to go about fetching a disabled person just for the sake of serving as a tool of transliteration?
en: Don't you think it's a bit dehumanizing to go about fetching a disabled person just for the sake of serving as a tool of transliteration?
ja: 障がいのある人をわざわざ連れてきて、翻訳の道具として使うだけって、少し人間性を欠くと思わない?

key: I suppose you wouldn't.
en: I suppose you wouldn't.
ja: まあ、あんたはそうは思わないでしょうけど。

key: But I, for one, am discontent to play a passive, intermediary role in all this.
en: But I, for one, am discontent to play a passive, intermediary role in all this.
ja: でも、わたくしとしては、この一件でただの受動的な仲介役に甘んじるのは不満なの。

key: So, here's what we're going to do.
en: So, here's what we're going to do.
ja: だから、こうしましょう。

key: I trust you are familiar with the game "Simon Says"?
en: I trust you are familiar with the game "Simon Says"?
ja: 「サイモン・セズ」ってゲーム、知ってるでしょう?

key: DANIELLE: You say that, but the last time I translated for someone, they said they knew it and then forgot the entire point of the game.
en: DANIELLE: You say that, but the last time I translated for someone, they said they knew it and then forgot the entire point of the game.
ja: ダニエール: そう言うけれど、以前わたくしが誰かのために通訳したときは、知ってるって言った人が、そのゲームの肝心な部分をすっかり忘れていたのよね。

key: If I don't specifically say "Simon Says", you don't do the thing, remember.
en: If I don't specifically say "Simon Says", you don't do the thing, remember.
ja: 特に「サイモン・セズ」って言わなかったら、その動作はしない、覚えておいて。

key: But if you get that, then you get where I'm going with this.
en: But if you get that, then you get where I'm going with this.
ja: でも、それがわかっているなら、わたくしが何をしようとしているかもわかるでしょう。

key: DANIELLE: Truly? Goodness, some folks are even more sheltered than I'd thought.
en: DANIELLE: Truly? Goodness, some folks are even more sheltered than I'd thought.
ja: ダニエール: 本当に? あら、まあ、思っていたよりも世間知らずな人がいるものね。

key: Fret not. I shall kindly explain it for you.
en: Fret not. I shall kindly explain it for you.
ja: 心配しないで。ちゃんと親切に説明してさしあげるわ。

key: In "Simon Says," players are given a list of instructions one at a time by a leader.
en: In "Simon Says," players are given a list of instructions one at a time by a leader.
ja: 「サイモン・セズ」では、リーダーが一度に一つずつ、指示を出すの。

key: If the instruction is preceded by the phrase "Simon says," then each player is to perform it.
en: If the instruction is preceded by the phrase "Simon says," then each player is to perform it.
ja: その指示の前に「サイモン・セズ」というフレーズがついていたら、プレイヤーはそれを実行する。

key: If it is not preceded by that phrase, players are expected to ignore it.
en: If it is not preceded by that phrase, players are expected to ignore it.
ja: そのフレーズがついていなければ、プレイヤーはそれを無視するべき。

key: If a player fails to do something Simon said, or does do something Simon did not say, then they lose.
en: If a player fails to do something Simon said, or does do something Simon did not say, then they lose.
ja: サイモンが言ったことをしなかったり、逆に言ってもいないことをしたりしたら、負け。

key: Simple enough, isn't it? Even a child could win flawlessly.
en: Simple enough, isn't it? Even a child could win flawlessly.
ja: 簡単すぎるくらいでしょう? 子供だって完璧に勝てるわ。

key: So, we will play this game as I read you the instructions for the ritual.
en: So, we will play this game as I read you the instructions for the ritual.
ja: というわけで、わたくしがあなたに儀式の指示を読み上げながら、このゲームで進めましょう。

key: Surely you, a perfectly-sighted person, can't possibly fail something as rudimentary as this, right?
en: Surely you, a perfectly-sighted person, can't possibly fail something as rudimentary as this, right?
ja: 目もちゃんと見えているあんたなら、こんな初歩的なことで失敗するはずないでしょう?

key: Now, talk to me again when you're ready to begin.
en: Now, talk to me again when you're ready to begin.
ja: さあ、準備ができたら、また話しかけて。

key: DANIELLE: Care to try again?
en: DANIELLE: Care to try again?
ja: ダニエール: もう一度やってみる?

key: Or has this simple set of instructions proven just ever too much for you to handle?
en: Or has this simple set of instructions proven just ever too much for you to handle?
ja: それとも、この簡単な指示があんたには手に負えなさすぎたかしら?

key: DANIELLE: Shall we get started?
en: DANIELLE: Shall we get started?
ja: ダニエール: 始めましょうか?

key: After all, I do so love tormenting people with games-- I mean, playing games with people.
en: After all, I do so love tormenting people with games-- I mean, playing games with people.
ja: 結局のところ、人をゲームでいじめるのって……いえ、人とゲームをするのって、とても好きなの。

key: DANIELLE: Lovely.
en: DANIELLE: Lovely.
ja: ダニエール: よろしいわ。

key: Now go stand over there, in that middle area. Then we'll begin.
en: Now go stand over there, in that middle area. Then we'll begin.
ja: さあ、あそこの真ん中のエリアに立って。それから始めましょう。

key: DANIELLE: No need to be nervous or anything.
en: DANIELLE: No need to be nervous or anything.
ja: ダニエール: 緊張する必要なんてないわよ。

key: I'm only here to judge and mock you.
en: I'm only here to judge and mock you.
ja: わたくしはただ、あんたを審査してからかうためにここにいるだけだもの。

key: DANIELLE: ...What?
en: DANIELLE: ...What?
ja: ダニエール: ……何?

key: DANIELLE: Messed up, did you?
en: DANIELLE: Messed up, did you?
ja: ダニエール: 失敗したのね?

key: At least you know it.
en: At least you know it.
ja: 自覚があるだけましだわ。

key: From the top, then, when you're ready.
en: From the top, then, when you're ready.
ja: じゃあ最初から、準備ができたらどうぞ。

key: DANIELLE: What, is a little children's game too much for you?
en: DANIELLE: What, is a little children's game too much for you?
ja: ダニエール: 何、子供のお遊戯くらい、あんたには荷が重すぎる?

key: I know I'm not exactly being nice here-- that would be boring.
en: I know I'm not exactly being nice here-- that would be boring.
ja: わたくし、ここでは別に優しくしてるわけじゃないの――それだと退屈でしょう。

key: But if you realllllly want, I can just solve it for you.
en: But if you realllllly want, I can just solve it for you.
ja: でも、あんたが本当にどうしてもって言うなら、代わりに解いてあげてもいいわよ。

key: DANIELLE: Disappointing.
en: DANIELLE: Disappointing.
ja: ダニエール: がっかりだわ。

key: But it's not as if I won't help.
en: But it's not as if I won't help.
ja: でも、手伝わないってわけじゃないの。

key: Stand back then, I'll take care of it in an instant.
en: Stand back then, I'll take care of it in an instant.
ja: じゃあ下がってて、あっという間に片付けるから。

key: DANIELLE: Your commitment to letting me bully you is sincerely appreciated.
en: DANIELLE: Your commitment to letting me bully you is sincerely appreciated.
ja: ダニエール: あんたがいじめられるのに付き合ってくれる姿勢、心からうれしいわ。

key: But the timing is messed up now, so let's go from the top.
en: But the timing is messed up now, so let's go from the top.
ja: でもタイミングがおかしくなっちゃったから、最初からやり直しましょう。

key: DANIELLE: Oh, so it wasn't all poppycock.
en: DANIELLE: Oh, so it wasn't all poppycock.
ja: ダニエール: あら、まるっきりのたわ言ってわけでもなかったのね。

key: Color me surprised.
en: Color me surprised.
ja: 驚いたわ。

key: Well, I don't expect you to thank me, and I have no intention of congratulating you, so run along now.
en: Well, I don't expect you to thank me, and I have no intention of congratulating you, so run along now.
ja: まあ、あんたに感謝されるとも思ってないし、褒めてあげるつもりもないから、もう行っていいわよ。

key: DANIELLE: Don't worry; I don't intend to disappear just yet.
en: DANIELLE: Don't worry; I don't intend to disappear just yet.
ja: ダニエール: 心配しないで、まだ消えるつもりはないから。

key: After all, I've gotten the impression that this won't be the last time you'll need me.
en: After all, I've gotten the impression that this won't be the last time you'll need me.
ja: だって、これがあんたがわたくしを必要とする最後になるとは思えないもの。

key: And I'm sure you would just hate to miss out on our little games.
en: And I'm sure you would just hate to miss out on our little games.
ja: それに、あんたも、わたくしたちのちょっとしたゲームを見逃すのは嫌でしょうしね。

key: Kzzzzzztttt--
en: Kzzzzzztttt--
ja: Kzzzzzztttt--

key: The Pokémon fled further inward!
en: The Pokémon fled further inward!
ja: ポケモンはさらに奥へと逃げていった!

key: Small bumps cover the tablet from side to side in distinct patterns...
en: Small bumps cover the tablet from side to side in distinct patterns...
ja: 石板には、独特な模様で細かい突起が一面に広がっている……

key: DANIELLE: So there were more, after all.
en: DANIELLE: So there were more, after all.
ja: ダニエール: なるほど、やっぱりもっとあったのね。

key: Of course, I already knew that, but I wouldn't want to rob you of your feeling of discovery.
en: Of course, I already knew that, but I wouldn't want to rob you of your feeling of discovery.
ja: もちろん、わたくしはとっくに知っていたけれど、あんたから発見の喜びを奪いたくはなかったの。

key: Never say I'm not generous.
en: Never say I'm not generous.
ja: わたくしを、ケチな人間だなんて思わないでね。

key: Now, step back. I'll read this and tell you when I'm ready.
en: Now, step back. I'll read this and tell you when I'm ready.
ja: さあ、下がって。読んだら準備ができたと伝えるわ。

key: DANIELLE: Another, right?
en: DANIELLE: Another, right?
ja: ダニエール: また一枚、ね?

key: What would you do without me?
en: What would you do without me?
ja: わたくしがいなかったら、あんたどうするつもりだったのかしら?

key: Now, stand aside and be useless for a moment again while I read this.
en: Now, stand aside and be useless for a moment again while I read this.
ja: さあ、これを読んでいる間、また少し脇に寄って役立たずでいてちょうだい。

key: DANIELLE: And again.
en: DANIELLE: And again.
ja: ダニエール: そして、また。

key: Any more of these and I should start charging you.
en: Any more of these and I should start charging you.
ja: これ以上あったら、あんたに料金を請求し始めるところよ。

key: I won't-- but I could.
en: I won't-- but I could.
ja: しないけど――できなくはないの。

key: So you'd better be nice to me, or something.
en: So you'd better be nice to me, or something.
ja: だから、わたくしに優しくしておいた方がいいわよ、とか何とか。

key: Anyway, you know the drill. Move.
en: Anyway, you know the drill. Move.
ja: とにかく、やり方はわかってるでしょう。動いて。

key: DANIELLE: All right, I've got it.
en: DANIELLE: All right, I've got it.
ja: ダニエール: よし、わかったわ。

key: Ready when you are.
en: Ready when you are.
ja: 準備ができたらどうぞ。

key: DANIELLE: Nothing to it but to do it.
en: DANIELLE: Nothing to it but to do it.
ja: ダニエール: あとはやるだけよ。

key: Oh, and just a suggestion-- do try not to mess up this time.
en: Oh, and just a suggestion-- do try not to mess up this time.
ja: ああ、それと一つ提案。今回は失敗しないようにしてね。

key: Optional, but recommended.
en: Optional, but recommended.
ja: 任意だけど、おすすめよ。

key: Now, shall we?
en: Now, shall we?
ja: さあ、始めましょうか?

key: DANIELLE: Ready to dance?
en: DANIELLE: Ready to dance?
ja: ダニエール: 踊る準備はいい?

key: DANIELLE: Right.
en: DANIELLE: Right.
ja: ダニエール: よし。

key: Start to the left of the center rock. Then we'll go.
en: Start to the left of the center rock. Then we'll go.
ja: 中央の岩の左から始めて。それから行くわ。

key: DANIELLE: Take your time. I hear art can't be rushed.
en: DANIELLE: Take your time. I hear art can't be rushed.
ja: ダニエール: 焦らずに。芸術は急いじゃいけないっていうものね。

key: DANIELLE: Well, go on now.
en: DANIELLE: Well, go on now.
ja: ダニエール: さあ、進んで。

key: DANIELLE: Oh, so you did it after all.
en: DANIELLE: Oh, so you did it after all.
ja: ダニエール: あら、結局やってのけたのね。

key: What a shame.
en: What a shame.
ja: 残念だわ。

key: Well, go on now.
en: Well, go on now.
ja: さあ、進んで。

key: DANIELLE: Your ability to follow simple instructions is truly astounding, \PN.
en: DANIELLE: Your ability to follow simple instructions is truly astounding, \PN.
ja: ダニエール: 簡単な指示に従う能力、本当に見事だわ、\PN。

key: REGIROCK: Rrrrzzzzt!
en: REGIROCK: Rrrrzzzzt!
ja: レジロック: ガリガリガリッ!

key: DANIELLE: All done.
en: DANIELLE: All done.
ja: ダニエール: 全部終わったわ。

key: Talk to me when you're ready.
en: Talk to me when you're ready.
ja: 準備ができたら話しかけて。

key: DANIELLE: That cracked ice should reform if we wait a spell.
en: DANIELLE: That cracked ice should reform if we wait a spell.
ja: ダニエール: あの割れた氷、少し待てば元に戻るはずよ。

key: Given the Pokémon at hand, it shouldn't take long.
en: Given the Pokémon at hand, it shouldn't take long.
ja: 相手のポケモンを考えれば、そう時間はかからないはずよ。

key: When it's set, will you try again?
en: When it's set, will you try again?
ja: 準備ができたら、もう一度挑戦する?

key: DANIELLE: Before we get started here, I should explain something.
en: DANIELLE: Before we get started here, I should explain something.
ja: ダニエール: 始める前に、説明しておくことがあるわ。

key: This tablet instructs a person to slide across this patch of ice in various directions,
en: This tablet instructs a person to slide across this patch of ice in various directions,
ja: この石板には、氷のこの区画をさまざまな方向に滑って渡るよう指示が書かれているの。

key: So when I say "Slide left," for instance, all you need to do is cross the ice patch in that direction.
en: So when I say "Slide left," for instance, all you need to do is cross the ice patch in that direction.
ja: だから、たとえば「左に滑って」と言ったら、その方向に氷の区画を渡るだけでいいのよ。

key: Two caveats:
en: Two caveats:
ja: 注意点が二つ。

key: First, it must be the center mass of the ice. The edges do not count.
en: First, it must be the center mass of the ice. The edges do not count.
ja: 一つ、氷の中央部分でなければならないわ。端は数えないの。

key: Second, I can tell that the ice is cracked in some places.
en: Second, I can tell that the ice is cracked in some places.
ja: 二つ、氷が所々ひび割れているのがわかるでしょう。

key: Should the ice break and you get stuck on a patch of bare ground, this will fail the ritual.
en: Should the ice break and you get stuck on a patch of bare ground, this will fail the ritual.
ja: 氷が割れて、何もない地面の区画に取り残されたら、この儀式は失敗になるわ。

key: Are we clear?
en: Are we clear?
ja: わかった?

key: DANIELLE: Good.
en: DANIELLE: Good.
ja: ダニエール: よろしい。

key: Then, are you ready?
en: Then, are you ready?
ja: それじゃ、準備はいい?

key: DANIELLE: Very well; I'll go again.
en: DANIELLE: Very well; I'll go again.
ja: ダニエール: よろしい、もう一度やるわ。

key: DANIELLE: Let's get it done.
en: DANIELLE: Let's get it done.
ja: ダニエール: さあ、やりましょう。

key: Stand near the ice; the exact position doesn't matter for this one.
en: Stand near the ice; the exact position doesn't matter for this one.
ja: 氷の近くに立って。今回は正確な位置は関係ないわ。

key: DANIELLE: Do what you must.
en: DANIELLE: Do what you must.
ja: ダニエール: やるべきことをやって。

key: DANIELLE: Simon says slide to the left. \wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says slide to the left. \wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、左に滑って。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says slide right.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says slide right.\wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、右に滑って。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Slide down now.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Slide down now.\wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: 今度は下に滑って。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says slide to the left again. \wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says slide to the left again. \wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、もう一度左に滑って。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Right once more. \wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Right once more.  \wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: もう一度右に。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says slide up.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says slide up.\wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、上に滑って。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Now slide down. \wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Now slide down. \wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: 今度は下に滑って。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says slide to the right.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says slide to the right.\wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、右に滑って。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Nothing?
en: DANIELLE: Nothing?
ja: ダニエール: 何も起きない?

key: I'll give you no grief this time, as this ritual seems particularly contrived.
en: I'll give you no grief this time, as this ritual seems particularly contrived.
ja: 今回はいじめないでおいてあげる、この儀式はやけに作り込まれているようだから。

key: It is likely there's some figuring to be done to work around the cracks.
en: It is likely there's some figuring to be done to work around the cracks.
ja: ひび割れを避けて考えなきゃいけない部分があるみたいね。

key: DANIELLE: ...Right.
en: DANIELLE: ...Right.
ja: ダニエール: ……そうね。

key: This one's the most convoluted of the lot.
en: This one's the most convoluted of the lot.
ja: これがこの中で一番ややこしいわ。

key: I pride myself on being at least a little bit of a sassbucket, but I'm not going to tease you over this one.
en: I pride myself on being at least a little bit of a sassbucket, but I'm not going to tease you over this one.
ja: わたくし、少しは意地悪な自分に誇りを持っているけれど、これに関してはあんたをからかったりしないわ。

key: Simon Says is on hold; you can solve this on your own time.
en: Simon Says is on hold; you can solve this on your own time.
ja: サイモン・セズは一旦お休みよ、これは自分のペースで解いていいから。

key: Let me explain.
en: Let me explain.
ja: 説明させて。

key: The key points are the cracks in the ice.
en: The key points are the cracks in the ice.
ja: 重要なのは、氷のひび割れよ。

key: All five need to be broken, and there are specific directions you need to slide in when doing so,
en: All five need to be broken, and there are specific directions you need to slide in when doing so,
ja: 五つすべて割らなきゃいけなくて、それぞれ割るときに滑る方向が決まっているんだけど、

key: But we don't know the correct order to break them in.
en: But we don't know the correct order to break them in.
ja: 割る正しい順番は、わたくしたちにはわからないの。

key: If you break one sliding the wrong direction, it's a fail.
en: If you break one sliding the wrong direction, it's a fail.
ja: 間違った方向に滑って割ったら、失敗。

key: If you step on an already broken spot, it's a fail.
en: If you step on an already broken spot, it's a fail.
ja: すでに割れた場所を踏んでも、失敗。

key: The correct order is...
en: The correct order is...
ja: 正しい順番は……

key: Left, Right, Left, Up, Right.
en: Left, Right, Left, Up, Right.
ja: 左、右、左、上、右。

key: Five slides in those directions, each one breaking ice.
en: Five slides in those directions, each one breaking ice.
ja: その方向に五回滑って、それぞれ氷を割る。

key: Ask me again if you want a refresher, or if you want to kill time until the ice reforms.
en: Ask me again if you want a refresher, or if you want to kill time until the ice reforms.
ja: もう一度確認したいときや、氷が元に戻るまで時間を潰したいときは、また話しかけて。

key: It'll just, do that, I guess.
en: It'll just, do that, I guess.
ja: 多分、それだけのことよ。

key: DANIELLE: What is it?
en: DANIELLE: What is it?
ja: ダニエール: どうしたの?

key: DANIELLE: Give it time and it's as good as new.
en: DANIELLE: Give it time and it's as good as new.
ja: ダニエール: 時間が経てば、また新品同然になるわ。

key: DANIELLE: Break all five cracks in the ice by sliding in a specific order.
en: DANIELLE: Break all five cracks in the ice by sliding in a specific order.
ja: ダニエール: 決まった順番で滑って、氷のひび割れを五つ全部割って。

key: The order is: Left, Right, Left, Up, Right.
en: The order is: Left, Right, Left, Up, Right.
ja: 順番は、左、右、左、上、右。

key: If you break one sliding in the wrong direction, it's a fail.
en: If you break one sliding in the wrong direction, it's a fail.
ja: 間違った方向に滑って割ったら、失敗。

key: DANIELLE: That's out of the way then.
en: DANIELLE: That's out of the way then.
ja: ダニエール: これで片付いたわね。

key: These rituals are so picky...
en: These rituals are so picky...
ja: この手の儀式って、本当に細かいことにうるさいのよね……

key: And you said this dimension was only created recently?
en: And you said this dimension was only created recently?
ja: それに、この次元は最近できたばかりって言ってたわよね?

key: Not likely judging by the feel of this stone--
en: Not likely judging by the feel of this stone--
ja: この石の感触からすると、そうは思えないけど――

key: But what do I know, I'm just a blind girl who likes to pick on people and complain.
en: But what do I know, I'm just a blind girl who likes to pick on people and complain.
ja: まあ、わたくしなんて、人をいじって文句を言うのが好きな、ただの目の見えない女の子でしかないけど。

key: DANIELLE: Go on; you shouldn't need me for this next part.
en: DANIELLE: Go on; you shouldn't need me for this next part.
ja: ダニエール: さあ、行って。次の部分にはわたくしは必要ないはずよ。

key: REGICE: Ssssszzzzt?
en: REGICE: Ssssszzzzt?
ja: レジアイス: シュゥゥゥゥゥ?

key: simon says...
en: simon says...
ja: サイモン・セズ……

key: don't forget me?
en: don't forget me?
ja: あたしのこと忘れないで?

key: REGISTEEL: Krrrrchzznvt--
en: REGISTEEL: Krrrrchzznvt--
ja: レジスチル: ガリガリガリガリッ――

key: DANIELLE: Done. This one should be no problem.
en: DANIELLE: Done. This one should be no problem.
ja: ダニエール: 終わったわ。これは問題ないはずよ。

key: Whenever you're ready.
en: Whenever you're ready.
ja: 準備ができたらいつでもどうぞ。

key: DANIELLE: Back for more? Not that I can blame you!
en: DANIELLE: Back for more? Not that I can blame you!
ja: ダニエール: また戻ってきたの? まあ、責める気はないけれど!

key: With the former ruthless dictator Simon ousted, a whole new world of possibility is open for us.
en: With the former ruthless dictator Simon ousted, a whole new world of possibility is open for us.
ja: 冷酷な独裁者サイモンが追い出されたことで、新しい可能性の世界が私たちに開かれたんだもの。

key: DANIELLE: Ready for another riveting game of Simon Says?
en: DANIELLE: Ready for another riveting game of Simon Says?
ja: ダニエール: もう一度、あのわくわくするサイモン・セズをやる準備はいい?

key: ...You know, now that I think about it...
en: ...You know, now that I think about it...
ja: ……ねえ、今考えてみたんだけど……

key: Just who is this Simon anyway?
en: Just who is this Simon anyway?
ja: そもそも、このサイモンって一体誰なの?

key: I don't even know a Simon; do you?
en: I don't even know a Simon; do you?
ja: サイモンなんて人、わたくし知らないんだけど、あんたは知ってる?

key: I don't think anybody names their kids "Simon" these days.
en: I don't think anybody names their kids "Simon" these days.
ja: 今どき、自分の子供に「サイモン」なんて名付ける人、いないと思うわ。

key: And with how bossy he seems to be, it's no wonder.
en: And with how bossy he seems to be, it's no wonder.
ja: あれだけ偉そうなところを見ると、無理もないけど。

key: What a tool.
en: What a tool.
ja: なんて道具みたいな人。

key: I've got a better idea.
en: I've got a better idea.
ja: もっといい考えがあるわ。

key: This time, we're playing "Danielle Says".
en: This time, we're playing "Danielle Says".
ja: 今度は「ダニエール・セズ」をやりましょう。

key: The rules are all the same, but the game is five times better now.
en: The rules are all the same, but the game is five times better now.
ja: ルールは全部同じだけど、ゲームは五倍良くなったわ。

key: Now are you prepared for this enhanced experience?
en: Now are you prepared for this enhanced experience?
ja: さあ、この強化された体験の準備はいい?

key: DANIELLE: Let's do it!
en: DANIELLE: Let's do it!
ja: ダニエール: やりましょう!

key: Stand in the center and Danielle's awesome Danielle Says game will commence!
en: Stand in the center and Danielle's awesome Danielle Says game will commence!
ja: 真ん中に立って、ダニエールの素晴らしいダニエール・セズが始まるわよ!

key: DANIELLE: I understand; it's a lot of awesome to take in at once.
en: DANIELLE: I understand; it's a lot of awesome to take in at once.
ja: ダニエール: わかるわ、一度に受け止めるには素晴らしすぎるものね。

key: Don't worry, I'll be here.
en: Don't worry, I'll be here.
ja: 心配しないで、わたくしはここにいるから。

key: I have faith that with proper preparation and a determined spirit, someday you will be able to withstand the sheer awesomeness of it all.
en: I have faith that with proper preparation and a determined spirit, someday you will be able to withstand the sheer awesomeness of it all.
ja: きちんと準備して、決意を持って臨めば、いつかあんたにもこの素晴らしさの全てに耐えられるようになると信じているわ。

key: DANIELLE: And it's done.
en: DANIELLE: And it's done.
ja: ダニエール: そして、これで終わり。

key: I suppose we can let the Danielle Says thing go anyway.
en: I suppose we can let the Danielle Says thing go anyway.
ja: まあ、ダニエール・セズはこれくらいにしておいてあげましょう。

key: DANIELLE: Oh, you did it!
en: DANIELLE: Oh, you did it!
ja: ダニエール: あら、できたのね!

key: Now that you've learned to listen to me instead of smelly old Nobody McSimonface, I suppose we can let it go.
en: Now that you've learned to listen to me instead of smelly old Nobody McSimonface, I suppose we can let it go.
ja: あの臭くて古い、名もなきサイモンなんとかの代わりに、わたくしの言うことを聞けるようになったんだから、これくらいにしておいてあげましょう。

key: Admittedly the alliteration does work better...
en: Admittedly the alliteration does work better...
ja: 正直、語呂合わせとしてはこっちの方がよくできてるんだけどね……

key: No matter! You have business, don't you?
en: No matter! You have business, don't you?
ja: まあいいわ! あんた、用事があるんでしょう?

key: DANIELLE: We will play this game again someday.
en: DANIELLE: We will play this game again someday.
ja: ダニエール: このゲームはまたいつかやりましょうね。

key: Turn which way?
en: Turn which way?
ja: どちら向きに回す?

key: DANIELLE: That's all of it, isn't it?
en: DANIELLE: That's all of it, isn't it?
ja: ダニエール: これで全部ね?

key: Legendary Pokémon in a new space dimension, huh...
en: Legendary Pokémon in a new space dimension, huh...
ja: 新しい空間次元に伝説のポケモンとはね……

key: This operation is being run out of DJ Arclight's Nightclub, right?
en: This operation is being run out of DJ Arclight's Nightclub, right?
ja: これって、DJアークライトのナイトクラブが仕切ってる件よね?

key: I can put two and two together.
en: I can put two and two together.
ja: わたくしにも、それくらいはわかるわ。

key: Perhaps I'll drop by and see if they need any other help.
en: Perhaps I'll drop by and see if they need any other help.
ja: 今度、他に何か手伝えることがないか、様子を見に行こうかしら。

key: I suppose I should thank you.
en: I suppose I should thank you.
ja: あんたにお礼を言うべきなのかもしれないわね。

key: After all, this is more interesting than sitting back in the lobby all day.
en: After all, this is more interesting than sitting back in the lobby all day.
ja: だって、一日中ロビーに座ってるより、こっちの方がずっと面白いもの。

key: I look forward to picking on you again someday~
en: I look forward to picking on you again someday~
ja: またいつか、あんたをいじりに来るのを楽しみにしてるわ～

key: you know, this has been fun?
en: you know, this has been fun?
ja: ねえ、これ結構楽しかったよね?

key: i should throw legendary items around more often!
en: i should throw legendary items around more often!
ja: もっとちょくちょく伝説アイテムばらまいてやろっかな!

key: say, have you checked your items pocket lately?
en: say, have you checked your items pocket lately?
ja: そうだ、最近アイテムポケット確認した?

key: nah, jk, i was just pullin' your leg.
en: nah, jk, i was just pullin' your leg.
ja: なーんて、冗談冗談、からかっただけだって。

key: ...unless...
en: ...unless...
ja: ……それとも……

key: wait, hold on, is that the prison bottle???
en: wait, hold on, is that the prison bottle???
ja: ちょっと待って、それ、まさかプリズンボトル???

key: who put THAT there?
en: who put THAT there?
ja: 誰があんなとこに置いたわけ?

key: okay, okay, i'm just kiddin' with you~
en: okay, okay, i'm just kiddin' with you~
ja: わかったわかった、ただの冗談だってば～

key: the only prison here is the one you're in now.
en: the only prison here is the one you're in now.
ja: ここにある唯一の独房なら、今あんたが入ってるそれだけだよ。

key: consigned to an eternity of being forced to check an over-stuffed backpack..............
en: consigned to an eternity of being forced to check an over-stuffed backpack..............
ja: パンパンのバックパックを永遠に確認し続けなきゃいけない運命、ってやつ..............

key: anyway, i'll stop talking to myself now, but--
en: anyway, i'll stop talking to myself now, but--
ja: とにかく、独り言はもうやめとくけど――

key: oh! i almost forgot to mention!
en: oh! i almost forgot to mention!
ja: あ! 言い忘れるとこだった!

key: i found another one of your friends lying around!
en: i found another one of your friends lying around!
ja: あんたの仲間、また一人見つけたよ!

key: keep an eye out, ok?
en: keep an eye out, ok?
ja: 気をつけて見ておいてね、いい?

key: DANIELLE: Simon says take one step right.\wtnp[30]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says take one step right.\wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、右に一歩進んで。\wtnp[30]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says face downward.\wtnp[30]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says face downward.\wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、下を向いて。\wtnp[30]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says take one step down and two steps left.\wtnp[30]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says take one step down and two steps left.\wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、下に一歩、左に二歩進んで。\wtnp[30]

key: DANIELLE: Now go up the stairs.\wtnp[30]
en: DANIELLE: Now go up the stairs.\wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: 今度は階段を上って。\wtnp[30]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says go up three paces.\wtnp[30]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says go up three paces.\wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、三歩上に進んで。\wtnp[30]

en: DANIELLE: Simon says touch the rock.\wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、岩に触って。\wtnp[30]

key: DANIELLE: Again. \wtnp[30]
en: DANIELLE: Again. \wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: もう一度。\wtnp[30]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says take one step right and two steps up.\wtnp[30]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says take one step right and two steps up.\wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、右に一歩、上に二歩進んで。\wtnp[30]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says face down again.\wtnp[30]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says face down again.\wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、もう一度下を向いて。\wtnp[30]

key: DANIELLE: And now face up.\wtnp[30]
en: DANIELLE: And now face up.\wtnp[30]
ja: ダニエール: そして今度は上を向いて。\wtnp[30]

key: DANIELLE: Hm~
en: DANIELLE: Hm~
ja: ダニエール: ふぅん～

key: Wrong.
en: Wrong.
ja: 間違いよ。

key: That was all of the instructions, so if you did it right, something would have happened.
en: That was all of the instructions, so if you did it right, something would have happened.
ja: これで指示は全部だったから、正しくやってれば何か起きてたはずよ。

key: Perhaps they were too complicated for you?

ja: もしかして、複雑すぎたかしら?

key: Would you like an easier version?
en: Would you like an easier version?
ja: もっと簡単なバージョンがいい?

key: Not that I'd give you one.
en: Not that I'd give you one.
ja: あげるつもりはないけど。

key: This is way more fun~
en: This is way more fun~
ja: こっちの方がずっと面白いもの～

key: DANIELLE: Simon says take one step down and two steps left. \wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says take one step down and two steps left. \wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、下に一歩、左に二歩進んで。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says push the grey rock right one space.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says push the grey rock right one space.\wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、灰色の岩を右に一マス押して。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says stand directly below the center stone.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says stand directly below the center stone.\wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、中央の石のすぐ下に立って。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says push the brown rock up one space.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says push the brown rock up one space.\wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、茶色の岩を上に一マス押して。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says touch the tallest rock. \wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says touch the tallest rock.  \wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、一番高い岩に触って。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Simon says push both boulders towards the center stone.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Simon says push both boulders towards the center stone.\wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: サイモン・セズ、両方の岩を中央の石の方へ押して。\wtnp[35]

en: DANIELLE: Now move the grey stone up one space and right one space. \wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: 今度は、灰色の石を上に一マス、右に一マス動かして。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Move the brown rock to the opposite side of the center stone.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Move the brown rock to the opposite side of the center stone.\wtnp[35]
ja: ダニエール: 茶色の岩を中央の石の反対側に動かして。\wtnp[35]

key: DANIELLE: Then push the grey rock right one space and down one space.\wtnp[35]
en: DANIELLE: Then push the grey rock right one space and down one space.\wtnp[35]
